mapper.sql: ANALYSISID, ANALYSISNO, ANALYSISNAME, PREDICTIONTYPE, MODELID, INPUTDATA, PREDICTIONPERIOD, PREDICTIONHORIZON, PREDICTIONRESULT, CONFIDENCELEVEL, CONFIDENCEINTERVAL, ACCURACY, ANALYSISDATE, ANALYSISTIME, VALIDATIONDATE, ACTUALRESULT, DEVIATIONANALYSIS, ANALYSISSTATUS, REMARK, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE PREDICTIONTYPE = #{predictionType} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY ANALYSISDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE MODELID = #{modelId} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY ANALYSISDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ANALYSISSTATUS = #{analysisStatus} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY ANALYSISDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ANALYSISSTATUS = 'PENDING' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ANALYSISSTATUS = 'RUNNING' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY ANALYSISTIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ANALYSISSTATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY ANALYSISDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ANALYSISSTATUS = 'FAILED' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY UPDATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ANALYSISDATE >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{days}' DAY ORDER BY ANALYSISDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ANALYSISDATE + PREDICTIONHORIZON < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY ANALYSISDATE ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ANALYSISDATE + PREDICTIONHORIZON BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '#{days}' DAY ORDER BY ANALYSISDATE ASC

SELECT PREDICTIONTYPE AS predictionType, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage, AVG(ACCURACY) AS avgAccuracy FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY PREDICTIONTYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ANALYSISSTATUS AS analysisStatus, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY ANALYSISSTATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT MODELID AS modelId, COUNT(*) AS usageCount, AVG(ACCURACY) AS avgAccuracy, COUNT(CASE WHEN ANALYSISSTATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ANALYSISSTATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failedCount FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY MODELID ORDER BY usageCount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN ACCURACY >= 90 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN ACCURACY >= 80 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN ACCURACY >= 70 THEN 'AVERAGE' ELSE 'POOR' END AS accuracyLevel, COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(ACCURACY) AS avgAccuracy, MIN(ACCURACY) AS minAccuracy, MAX(ACCURACY) AS maxAccuracy FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ACCURACY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN ACCURACY >= 90 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN ACCURACY >= 80 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN ACCURACY >= 70 THEN 'AVERAGE' ELSE 'POOR' END ORDER BY avgAccuracy DESC

SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ACCURACY IS NOT NULL AND ANALYSISSTATUS = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY ACCURACY DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalPredictions, AVG(ACCURACY) AS avgAccuracy, COUNT(CASE WHEN ACCURACY >= 90 THEN 1 END) AS excellentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ACCURACY >= 80 AND ACCURACY < 90 THEN 1 END) AS goodCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ACCURACY < 80 THEN 1 END) AS poorCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ANALYSISSTATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ANALYSISSTATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failedCount FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE MODELID = #{modelId} AND ORGID = #{orgId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalPredictions, COUNT(CASE WHEN PREDICTIONRESULT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS predictionsWithResults, COUNT(CASE WHEN ACTUALRESULT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS validatedPredictions, COUNT(CASE WHEN DEVIATIONANALYSIS IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS deviationAnalyzed, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN PREDICTIONRESULT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS resultCoverage, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN ACTUALRESULT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS validationCoverage FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CREATETIME < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{retentionDays}' DAY AND ANALYSISSTATUS IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED')
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS SET INPUTDATA = NULL, PREDICTIONRESULT = NULL WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ANALYSISDATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90' DAY
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ( (ACCURACY IS NOT NULL AND ACCURACY < 0) OR (ACCURACY IS NOT NULL AND ACCURACY > 100) OR (PREDICTIONHORIZON IS NOT NULL AND PREDICTIONHORIZON <= 0) OR (CONFIDENCELEVEL IS NOT NULL AND (CONFIDENCELEVEL < 0 OR CONFIDENCELEVEL > 100)) ) ORDER BY UPDATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_PREDICTIVE_ANALYSIS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ANALYSISSTATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ACTUALRESULT IS NULL AND ANALYSISDATE + PREDICTIONHORIZON < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY ANALYSISDATE ASC
